verses.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: Demais veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
verses.pt: Tu pois, ó filho do homem, acaso julgarás, julgarás mesmo a cidade sanguinária? Então faze-lhe conhecer todas as suas abominações,
verses.en_web: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
verses.en_bbe: And you, son of man, will you be a judge, will you be a judge of the town of blood? then make clear to her all her disgusting ways.

verses.en: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.pt: e dize: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: A cidade que derrama o sangue dentro de si, para que venha o seu tempo! que faz ídolos contra si mesma, para se contaminar!
verses.en_web: You shall say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!
verses.en_bbe: And you are to say, This is what the Lord has said: A town causing blood to be drained out in her streets so that her time may come, and making images in her to make her unclean!

verses.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.pt: Pelo teu sangue que derramaste te fizeste culpada, e pelos teus ídolos que fabricaste te contaminaste; e fizeste aproximar-se o teu dia, e é chegado o fim dos teus anos. Por isso eu te fiz o opróbrio das nações e o escárnio de todas as terras.
verses.en_web: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come even to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.
verses.en_bbe: You are responsible for the blood drained out by you, and you are unclean through the images which you have made; and you have made your day come near, and the time of your judging has come; for this cause I have made you a name of shame to the nations and a cause of laughing to all countries.

verses.en: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
verses.pt: As que estão perto e as que estão longe de ti escarnecerão de ti, infamada, cheia de tumulto.
verses.en_web: Those who are near, and those who are far from you, will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.
verses.en_bbe: Those who are near and those who are far from you will make sport of you; your name is unclean, you are full of sounds of fear.

verses.en: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
verses.pt: Eis que os príncipes de Israel, que estão em ti, cada um conforme o seu poder, se esforçam para derramarem sangue.
verses.en_web: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
verses.en_bbe: See, the rulers of Israel, every one in his family, have been causing death in you.

verses.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.pt: No meio de ti desprezaram ao pai e à mãe; no meio de ti usaram de opressão para com o estrangeiro; no meio de ti foram injustos para com o órfão e a viúva.
verses.en_web: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.
verses.en_bbe: In you they have had no respect for father and mother; in you they have been cruel to the man from a strange land; in you they have done wrong to the child without a father and to the widow.

verses.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
verses.pt: As minhas coisas santas desprezaste, e os meus sábados profanaste.
verses.en_web: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.
verses.en_bbe: You have made little of my holy things, and have made my Sabbaths unclean.

verses.en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
verses.pt: Em ti se acham homens que caluniam para derramarem sangue; em ti há os que comem sobre os montes; e cometem perversidade no meio de ti.
verses.en_web: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.
verses.en_bbe: In you there are men who say evil of others, causing death; in you they have taken the flesh with the blood for food; in your streets they have put evil designs into effect.

verses.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.pt: A vergonha do pai descobrem em ti; no meio de ti humilham a que está impura, na sua separação.
verses.en_web: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.
verses.en_bbe: In you they have let the shame of their fathers be seen; in you they have done wrong to a woman at the time when she was unclean.

verses.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.pt: Um comete abominação com a mulher do seu próximo, outro contamina abominavelmente a sua nora, e outro humilha no meio de ti a sua irmã, filha de seu pai.
verses.en_web: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife; and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.en_bbe: And in you one man has done what was disgusting with his neighbour's wife; and another has made his daughter-in-law unclean; and another has done wrong to his sister, his father's daughter.

verses.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: Peitas se recebem no meio de ti para se derramar sangue; recebes usura e ganhos ilícitos, e usas de avareza com o teu próximo, oprimindo-o; mas de mim te esqueceste, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: In you they have taken rewards as the price of blood; you have taken interest and great profits, and you have taken away your neighbours' goods by force, and have not kept me in mind, says the Lord.

verses.en: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
verses.pt: Eis que, portanto, bato as mãos contra o lucro desonesto que ganhaste, e por causa do sangue que houve no meio de ti.
verses.en_web: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been within you.
verses.en_bbe: See, then, I have made my hands come together in wrath against your taking of goods by force and against the blood which has been flowing in you.

verses.en: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.pt: Poderá estar firme o teu coração? poderão estar fortes as tuas mãos, nos dias em que eu tratarei contigo? Eu, o Senhor, o disse, e o farei.
verses.en_web: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.
verses.en_bbe: Will your heart be high or your hands strong in the days when I take you in hand? I the Lord have said it and will do it.

verses.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
verses.pt: Espalhar-te-ei entre as nações e dispersar-te-ei pelas terras; e de ti consumirei a tua imundícia.
verses.en_web: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will consume your filthiness out of you.
verses.en_bbe: And I will send you in flight among the nations and wandering among the countries; and I will completely take away out of you everything which is unclean.

verses.en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.pt: E tu serás profanada em ti mesma, aos olhos das nações, e saberás que eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: You will be profaned in yourself, in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”
verses.en_bbe: And you will be made low before the eyes of the nations; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: De novo veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
verses.pt: Filho do homem, a casa de Israel se tornou para mim em escória; todos eles são bronze, e estanho, e ferro, e chumbo no meio da fornalha; em escória de prata eles se tornaram.
verses.en_web: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are brass, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, the children of Israel have become like the poorest sort of waste metal to me: they are all silver and brass and tin and iron and lead mixed with waste.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o Senhor Deus: Pois que todos vós vos tornastes em escória, por isso eis que eu vos ajuntarei no meio de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have all become waste metal, see, I will get you together inside Jerusalem.

verses.en: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
verses.pt: Como se ajuntam a prata, e o bronze, e o ferro, e o chumbo, e o estanho, no meio da fornalha, para assoprar o fogo sobre eles, a fim de se fundirem, assim vos ajuntarei na minha ira e no meu furor, e ali vos porei e vos fundirei.
verses.en_web: As they gather silver, brass, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it; so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there, and melt you.
verses.en_bbe: As they put silver and brass and iron and lead and tin together inside the oven, heating up the fire on it to make it soft; so will I get you together in my wrath and in my passion, and, heating the fire with my breath, will make you soft.

verses.en: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
verses.pt: Sim, congregar-vos-ei, e assoprarei sobre vós o fogo da minha ira; e sereis fundidos no meio dela.
verses.en_web: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, I will take you, breathing on you the fire of my wrath, and you will become soft in it.

verses.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.pt: Como se funde a prata no meio da fornalha, assim sereis fundidos no meio dela; e sabereis que eu, o Senhor, derramei o meu furor sobre vós.
verses.en_web: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.’”
verses.en_bbe: As silver becomes soft in the oven, so you will become soft in it; and you will be certain that I the Lord have let loose my passion on you.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: Também veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.pt: Filho do homem, dize-lhe a ela: Tu és uma terra que não está purificada, nem regada de chuvas no dia da indignação.
verses.en_web: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed, nor rained on in the day of indignation.’
verses.en_bbe: Son of man, say to her, You are a land on which no rain or thunderstorm has come in the day of wrath.

verses.en: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.pt: Conspiração dos seus profetas há no meio dela, como um leão que ruge, que arrebata a presa; eles devoram vidas humanas; tomam tesouros e coisas preciosas; multiplicam as suas viúvas no meio dela.
verses.en_web: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.
verses.en_bbe: Her rulers in her are like a loud-voiced lion violently taking his food; they have made a meal of souls; they have taken wealth and valued property; they have made great the number of widows in her.

verses.en: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.pt: Os seus sacerdotes violentam a minha lei, e profanam as minhas coisas santas; não fazem diferença entre o santo e o profano, nem ensinam a discernir entre o impuro e o puro; e de meus sábados escondem os seus olhos, e assim sou profanado no meio deles.
verses.en_web: Her priests have done violence to my law, and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.
verses.en_bbe: Her priests have been acting violently against my law; they have made my holy things unclean: they have made no division between what is holy and what is common, and they have not made it clear that the unclean is different from the clean, and their eyes have been shut to my Sabbaths, and I am not honoured among them.

verses.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.pt: Os seus príncipes no meio dela são como lobos que arrebatam a presa: derramando o sangue, e destruindo vidas, para adquirirem lucro desonesto.
verses.en_web: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.
verses.en_bbe: Her rulers in her are like wolves violently taking their food; putting men to death and causing the destruction of souls, so that they may get their profit.

verses.en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
verses.pt: E os profetas têm feito para eles reboco com argamassa fraca tendo visões falsas, e adivinhando-lhes mentira, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor Deus; sem que o Senhor tivesse falado.
verses.en_web: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh,’ when Yahweh has not spoken.
verses.en_bbe: And her prophets have been using whitewash, seeing foolish visions and making false use of secret arts, saying, This is what the Lord has said, when the Lord has said nothing.

verses.en: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.pt: O povo da terra tem usado de opressão, e andado roubando e fazendo violência ao pobre e ao necessitado, e tem oprimido injustamente ao estrangeiro.
verses.en_web: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.
verses.en_bbe: The people of the land have been acting cruelly, taking men's goods by force; they have been hard on the poor and those in need, and have done wrong to the man from a strange land.

verses.en: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.pt: E busquei dentre eles um homem que levantasse o muro, e se pusesse na brecha perante mim por esta terra, para que eu não a destruísse; porém a ninguém achei.
verses.en_web: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
verses.en_bbe: And I was looking for a man among them who would make up the wall and take his station in the broken place before me for the land, so that I might not send destruction on it: but there was no one.

verses.en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: Por isso eu derramei sobre eles a minha indignação; com o fogo do meu furor os consumi; fiz que o seu caminho lhes recaísse sobre a cabeça, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And I let loose my passion on them, and have put an end to them in the fire of my wrath: I have made the punishment of their ways come on their heads, says the Lord.
